Chapter 6706: Moonwolf’S Temporal Howl

Chapter 6706: Moonwolf’s Temporal Howl

“Worry about surviving today first.” Li Qiye said.

The group exchanged glances and laughed loudly.

“You’re right, we have to survive today. I just got excited since listening to you is more beneficial than the greatest fortune.” Evil Transformation said.

“Indeed.” The other two bowed.

Such a scene was both unbelievable and deeply moving. Even in a life-and-death battle, there was still such kindness - an earnest and tireless exchange of knowledge. Moreover, neither side held anything back; it was as if they were pouring out everything they knew.

They were not only mortal enemies but also stood at the very pinnacle of existence. No being in the mortal world, no matter how hard they tried for a lifetime, could ever hope to reach their heights. Yet even with the possibility of dying in the very next moment, they still did not give up a single opportunity to seek the Dao.

On the other hand, how many cultivators felt content after becoming rulers of patriarchs, believing that they’ve achieved enough in this lifetime?

In contrast, these four immortals sought the Dao even in the face of death. Their relentless pursuit of knowledge and enlightenment stirred the crowd.

“I am glad that you three are not backing out of the agreement.” Li Qiye remarked.

“Don’t worry, Sacred Teacher. We immortals still have thin skin and will not renege on our promises.” Evil Transformation laughed.

“It’s not that bad to be killed by you either.” Fiendish Ground said.

The more Bao Pu listened, the more annoyed he became. He felt as if they were speaking deliberately to insult him.

“I still think we have a chance, Sacred Teacher.” Taichu said.

“Sure, nothing is certain in this world. After all, a fish can change into a dragon.” Li Qiye said.

“We hope to be those fish.” Taichu said.

“Just watch, we won’t let you down.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Together or one at a time?” Li Qiye asked.

The trio exchanged glances; the two primordial immortals stepped forward first.

“Sacred Teacher, we are first. Let us taste what it’s like to wear the high heaven’s body in a fight.” Evil Transformation said.

“You two deserve this.” Li Qiye said.

“If we lose, then Virtuous Nephew can join.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Of course.” Taichu bowed: “I anticipate great things from your new power, seniors.”

“Sacred Teacher, we brothers overestimate ourselves and wish to fight you.” They formally challenged.

“The arrow has been fired, this is it today, no reincarnation or anything. Any last words?” Li Qiye asked.

“No, nothing to worry about in the mortal world.” Evil Transformation said.

“No karma left for me either, I am ready.” Fiendish Ground laughed.

“Seems like I’m worldly in comparison.” Taichu said emotionally since he still had last words for Weizhen.

This was because he didn’t live long enough and Weizhen was still alive. Otherwise, he would have nothing to worry about either.

Listeners couldn’t help but feel that living too long might not be a blessing. An overwhelming sense of loneliness washed over them.

“No attachments yet still exercised self-restraint, a testament of determination before the shore.” Li Qiye said.

“It took time to correct our previous path, we’re fortunate to have come this far instead of dying earlier.” Evil Transformation said.

“We’re lucky to have met you.” Fiendish Ground added.

For a long time, the primordial immortals devoured the swamp until there was nothing left. After the chaos, some of them escaped to Three Immortals.

Of course, they were tempted to devour Three Immortals and had plenty of opportunities to do so. Their other brothers would have done so in any available world.

However, the six primordial immortals in Three Immortals only tried to reach the shore without resorting to devouring. Li Qiye respected them for this.

“Any lingering attachment left for you, Sacred Teacher?” Evil Transformation asked.

“I’m just a passerby. When I return this body, I will be me.” Li Qiye smiled: “Now, I’ll be using the divine beasts’ gifts to fight.”

“Sacred Teacher, I don’t think their gifts can reach the level of the high heaven.” Fiendish Ground laughed.

“We will find out. Although they couldn’t do it, it doesn’t mean I can’t.” Li Qiye said.

“Let us see how much you can elevate their gifts then. Please go ahead, Sacred Teacher.” Evil Transformation said.

“Very well, I will attack first now that you two have obtained a shored body.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Crack.” He transformed; his shoulder bones cracking and rising, making him appear like a giant wolf.

“Buzz.” A round moon appeared behind him, emitting time instead of moonlight.

“A moonwolf.” Taichu recognized the divine beast.

“Temporal Howl!” Li Qiye roared and released a single shockwave condensed of near-infinite time and space, enough to slay immortals.
